title: Lined Paper Planner Stickers-Icons
author: Happy Printables Club
description:
These are cute and colorful Lined Paper Icons Planner Stickers- Lined Paper Stickers  which will be perfect for your planner. You can use these in your notebooks, bullet journals, diaries, calendar, scrapbooking too. Just use them as you want and they will serve as a great functional stickers.
These are a great fun way to decorate your planner and also keep track of your events or issues.
Sticker Size: 0.5 x 0.5
Sheet Size: 4 x 5.5
WHAT YOU GET
You will get a ZIP file folder which includes:
1 JPEG 4 x 5.5
1 PNG 4 x 5.5
1 PDF 4 x 5.5
NO PHYSICAL PRODUCT WILL BE SHIPPED TO YOU- IT IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
PLEASE NOTE:
Depending on your computer monitor and resolution, colors may appear different from the actual download. Therefore there may be some variance between the way colors look on your screen compare to the actual print.
